title: Elixir of Dragonborn Prowess: Lightning

sources.title: Lightning Bolt
markers: | description = Call forth a blast of lightning that hits all creatures in the line of the eruption.

summary: Until Long Rest, gain Lightning resistance, advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion checks, and one cast of Lightning Bolt.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, gain Lightning resistance, advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion checks, and one cast of Lightning Bolt.
fields.Acquisition: Trade bronze or blue dragonborn blood to Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers or the Lower City.
fields.Stacking: Araj’s elixirs stack with ordinary elixirs and other Araj elixirs.
fields.Lightning Bolt: Action. In a 100 ft line, deal 8d6 Lightning, Dexterity save for half.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
